question: What ritual placement is prescribed when depositing on the ground with one's own name?
premises: The prescribed act is depositing or placing.
The stated condition is placement on the ground.
The item to be deposited is accompanied by one's own name.
inference: When placing on the ground, one should deposit the item together with one's own name.
uncertainties: The exact object to be deposited is not specified in this verse and depends on the preceding context.
plain_english: O goddess, if it is to be placed on the ground, one should deposit it accompanied by one's own name.
